description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'VersionedRedisTbCache' that extends Redis-based cache functionality with versioning support, including methods for getting, putting, and evicting cache entries with version control, and contains embedded Lua script for atomic versioned value setting.

classes.name: VersionedRedisTbCache
classes.description: An abstract cache class implementing versioned Redis cache operations with Lua scripting for atomic updates, supporting get, put, and evict with version control.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Retrieves a versioned value segment from Redis if the key is versioned; otherwise, delegates to superclass.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Puts a value into cache with versioning if the key is versioned; otherwise, delegates to superclass.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Overloaded method to put a value into Redis with a specific connection, supporting versioned keys.

methods.name: doPut
methods.description: Performs the actual put operation with version and expiration, using Redis scripting.

methods.name: doPut
methods.description: Performs the actual put operation with raw key, value, version, expiration, and Redis connection.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Evicts a cache entry by updating it with a specific version.
